context:
Goal: the silent-undo check reads the PR body the same way everywhere.
Problem (rule): your 411 a option said 'env PR_BODY in CI, --pr-body locally'. The old lane #1969 moved CI to the event file (GITHUB_EVENT_PATH) and a UTF-8 body file because an env string past 128 KB does not run on Linux, and a lint with no body source reads unknown. No owner word says that, so the lane asks. Your grant covers the act you named; a different mechanism is a variant.
Based on (read): old commits 60668a132 and a9dc07b7f (lane #1969 round 2) and the rebuild lane's report.
Departs from: your 411 a option — a reads the body from the event file in CI, with --pr-body locally, and the PR says so in a 'Departs from' line.
Meanwhile: the lane builds PR2 to a; PR1 and PR3 go on. Undo: change CI back to the env.
